name: Fixed HTML Toolbar
author: Yiannis Christodoulou

sections.description:
The Fixed HTML Toolbar plugin provides a sleek and customizable toolbar that can be displayed either at the top or bottom of your WordPress site. Ideal for showcasing social media icons, important notifications, or custom HTML content, this plugin ensures your key messages stay visible to users as they scroll through your site.

Key Features

  • Flexible Positioning: Display the toolbar at the top or bottom of the page based on your preference.
  • Customizable Design:
    • Choose background and border colors to match your site’s branding.
    • Adjust the toolbar’s border thickness and vertical padding for a polished look.
    • Define margins between icons for precise spacing.
  • Rich Content Options:
    • Add up to 5 linked icons with custom images for social media or other platforms.
    • Include custom HTML content directly in the toolbar using an intuitive editor.
  • Advanced Targeting:
    • Display the toolbar only on specific sections of your site (e.g., homepage, posts, pages, categories, or search results).
  • User-Friendly:
    • Easy-to-use settings panel for seamless configuration.
    • Add custom CSS for advanced styling flexibility.

Use Cases

  • Social Media Links: Keep your social profiles accessible to boost engagement.
  • Notifications: Highlight promotional offers, updates, or other important information.
  • Custom HTML Content: Add forms, banners, or any other HTML-based elements.
sections.installation:
The plugin is simple to install:

  1. Download the file fixed-html-toolbar.zip.
  2. Unzip it.
  3. Upload fixed-html-toolbar directory to your /wp-content/plugins directory.
  4. Go to the plugin management page and enable the plugin.
  5. Configure the options from the Settings > Fixed HTML Toolbar page.
sections.faq:
What is the Fixed HTML Toolbar plugin used for?

The Fixed HTML Toolbar lets you add a sticky bar at the top or bottom of your WordPress site to display social media icons, important notifications, contact info, promotional banners, or any custom HTML content that should stay visible while visitors scroll.

Will the toolbar stay visible while users scroll the page?

Yes. The toolbar is sticky (CSS position: fixed), so it remains visible at either the top or the bottom of the screen at all times, regardless of how far the visitor scrolls.

How many icons or links can I add to the toolbar?

You can add up to 5 linked icons — perfect for social profiles such as Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok — or replace them with fully custom HTML content using the built-in editor.

Can I show the toolbar only on specific pages or post types?

Yes. Under “Locations”, you can choose to display the toolbar only on selected sections of your site: homepage, posts, pages, categories, archives, or search results.

Can I match the toolbar style to my site’s branding?

Absolutely. You can customize the background color, border color, border thickness, vertical padding, and the spacing between icons. For advanced styling, you can also add your own custom CSS directly from the settings panel.

Is the Fixed HTML Toolbar mobile-friendly?

Yes. The toolbar is fully responsive and adapts to mobile screens. It is also automatically hidden when the visitor prints a web page, so it does not appear in printed copies.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The Fixed HTML Toolbar is theme-independent and works with virtually any modern WordPress theme (block themes, classic themes, page builders such as Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks, and more) without modification.

Will the toolbar affect my page speed or Core Web Vitals?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads its small CSS/JS assets when the toolbar is actually displayed, keeping your PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals scores intact.

Why choose Fixed HTML Toolbar?

With its powerful customization options, easy setup, and granular display rules, the Fixed HTML Toolbar plugin keeps your most important content — social links, promotions, or alerts — in the spotlight without disrupting the user experience.
